Save a lapidary plot at a named size preset

Source: R/ggsave.R
ggsave_lapidary.Rd

Wraps ggplot2::ggsave() with the poster/web size + dpi presets and, crucially, sets showtext's DPI to match so text metrics are correct in print output (the recurring gotcha in the prototype). Uses the ragg PNG device when available for crisper text.

Usage

ggsave_lapidary(plot, filename, preset = "web", ...)

Arguments

plot

A ggplot (or patchwork) object.

filename

Output path. The device is inferred from the extension (.png, .pdf, ...).

preset

A name from lap_preset_names().

...

Overrides passed to ggplot2::ggsave() (width, height, dpi, ...).

Value

filename, invisibly.

Details

This does not re-theme the plot; build the plot with theme_lapidary(base_size = lap_preset(preset)$base_size) (the milestone-2 builders take a preset/base_size argument that does this).
